Bases: object

Beta annealing schedule for variational models.

Parameters:

  • beta (float, optional) – Maximum beta value.

  • beta_min (float, optional) – Minimum beta value.

  • num_epoch_to_warmup (int, optional) – Number of epochs to linearly increase beta.

  • num_epochs_to_hold (int, optional) – Number of epochs to maintain full beta in cyclic mode.
